title: Blue Dunes Polished
description: Blue Dunes Polished is a granite slab characterized by its cream and grey grain and walnut colored veins. Granite is an incredibly hard and dense natural material that is commonly used for kitchen countertops because it is resistant to scratching, acids, and heat. Because it is incredibly hard and dense and is non-absorbent, granite can also be used in wet areas, on floors, walls, fireplace surrounds and in outdoor applications. The shine on polished granite is polished into the surface using fine abrasives. It is not a topical coating and will not wear off from normal use. The Leather finish is applied to the surface with diamond - tipped brushes that leave a dimpled texture. Although granite is resistant to acid etching, it isn’t indestructible. Over time,acidic cleansers may cause pitting. We recommend using a pH-natural stone cleanser. Monterrey Tile does not recommend placing hot items directly on the surface of any natural stone slab. The sudden temperature change can cause thermal shock, which may crack the surface. Additionally, liquids and oils on the surface of a hot pot/pan can cause discoloration.

description: Explosion Blue Polished is an elegant tan natural quartzite characterized by swirling greys. This marble-like stone resembles mother of pearl. The warm neutrals combined with its classical appearance gives Mont Blanc a versatile look that pairs well with any color or style. Quartzite is a natural stone resembling marble and slightly harder than granite. description: Olympian White Danby is a premium marble quarried from the Dorset Mountain in Vermont, home to the worlds largest underground quarry. Renowned for its remarkable density, it possesses an exceptionally low absorption rate of approximately 0.08%, making it significantly more resistant to staining than many European counterparts like Carrara. Its durability and timeless elegance have made it a preferred choice for iconic landmarks, including the U.S. Supreme Court and the Thomas Jefferson Memorial. Whether applied to kitchen countertops or interior flooring, it offers a sophisticated, clean aesthetic that only grows more beautiful with age. Olympian White Danby is a versatile natural stone suitable for a wide range of interior and exterior applications.

title: White Macaubas
description: White Macaubas is an exquisite natural quartzite quarried in Brazil, highly sought after for its sophisticated marble-like appearance and superior durability. It features a crisp white to ivory background accented by distinctive, linear horizontal veining in shades of charcoal, light gray, and occasionally soft taupe or gold. This metamorphic stone is exceptionally hard, offering high resistance to heat and scratching, making it a premier choice for high-traffic areas like kitchen islands and bathroom vanities. Interestingly, while its elegant striations often lead it to be mistaken for marble, White Macaubas possesses a mineral density closer to granite, providing a luxurious aesthetic without the typical fragility of softer stones. White Macaubas is a versatile natural stone suitable for a wide range of interior and exterior applications.

title: Cipollino Ondulato
description: Cipollino Ondulato is a visually arresting Italian marble quarried from the Apuan Alps in Tuscany. True to its name—Cipollino meaning little onion—it features dramatic, undulating waves reminiscent of an onion's layers. This stone is celebrated for its sophisticated palette of deep forest greens, charcoal greys, and creamy whites, often accented by chocolate browns or burgundies. Its high-contrast movement makes it a favorite for book-matched installations, transforming surfaces into natural works of art. Interestingly, while primarily associated with green tones, its rich mineral composition can produce “”Rosso”” variations featuring vivid purple and red striations. Cipollino Ondulato is a versatile natural stone suitable for a wide range of interior and exterior applications.

title: Bianco Dolomiti
description: Bianco Dolomiti is an exquisite white marble from the upper echelon of natural stones, primarily quarried in Turkey despite its frequent association with Italian design. This dolomitic marble is distinguished by its fine, milky-white background and smooth, subtle gray veining, offering a cleaner and more consistent aesthetic than many traditional marbles. Its unique composition includes over 40% calcium magnesium carbonate, providing a higher density and greater durability that makes it suitable for high-traffic indoor surfaces and even certain outdoor applications. Its understated elegance and soft texture have made it a favorite for modern, minimalist designs. Interestingly, its high magnesium content not only enhances its strength but also gives it a signature “”paint-like”” clarity that defines luxury in contemporary architecture. Bianco Dolomiti is a versatile natural stone suitable for a wide range of interior and exterior applications.

title: Volcano
description: Volcano Polished is a granite slab characterized by its earthy rust colors and volcanic black swirls. Reminiscent of flowing magma caught midway through the solidification. Granite is an incredibly hard and dense natural material that is commonly used for kitchen countertops because it is resistant to scratching, acids, and heat. Because it is incredibly hard and dense and is non-absorbent, granite can also be used in wet areas, on floors, walls, fireplace surrounds and in outdoor applications. The shine on polished granite is polished into the surface using fine abrasives. It is not a topical coating and will not wear off from normal use. The Leather finish is applied to the surface with diamond - tipped brushes that leave a dimpled texture. Although granite is resistant to acid etching, it isn’t indestructible. Over time,acidic cleansers may cause pitting. We recommend using a pH-natural stone cleanser. Monterrey Tile does not recommend placing hot items directly on the surface of any natural stone slab. The sudden temperature change can cause thermal shock, which may crack the surface. Additionally, liquids and oils on the surface of a hot pot/pan can cause discoloration.

title: Virginia Mist
description: Virginia Mist, also known as Jet Mist, is a premier black granite quarried from the Blue Ridge Mountains of Virginia. Characterized by its deep charcoal to black background, this stone features delicate, wispy white or light gray veining that creates a soft, cloud-like “”mist”” across the surface. Its exceptional density and low water absorption make it highly resistant to staining and weather, making it a popular choice for both luxurious interior countertops and demanding exterior applications. Notably, Virginia Mist was selected for the Ground Zero Memorial in New York City, a testament to its enduring strength and solemn beauty. Although often classified as granite in the trade, it is geologically a gabbro, which contributes to its intense dark coloring and superior durability. Virginia Mist is a versatile natural stone suitable for a wide range of interior and exterior applications.

description: Titanium Gold, also known as Cosmic Black, is a visually stunning granite quarried in the heart of Brazil. title: Infinity White
description: Infinity White is a prestigious natural quartzite primarily quarried from the rich mineral deposits of Brazil. This stone is celebrated for its luminous off-white to soft grey background, elegantly interlaced with fine, inky tracer lines and delicate crystalline structures that provide a shimmering depth. As a true metamorphic quartzite, it offers a hardness surpassing granite, making it exceptionally resistant to heat, scratches, and acidic etching. Its sophisticated, marble-like aesthetic combined with rugged durability makes it a premier choice for high-traffic waterfall islands and luxurious vanities. Interestingly, its dense composition is so formidable that it often requires specialized heavy-duty gang saws typically reserved for the toughest granites to process its slabs. Infinity White is a versatile natural stone suitable for a wide range of interior and exterior applications.

Because it is incredibly hard and dense and is non-absorbent, granite can also be used in wet areas, on floors, walls, fireplace surrounds and in outdoor applications. The shine on polished granite is polished into the surface using fine abrasives. It is not a topical coating and will not wear off from normal use. The Leather finish is applied to the surface with diamond - tipped brushes that leave a dimpled texture. Although granite is resistant to acid etching, it isn’t indestructible. Over time,acidic cleansers may cause pitting. We recommend using a pH-natural stone cleanser. Monterrey Tile does not recommend placing hot items directly on the surface of any natural stone slab. The sudden temperature change can cause thermal shock, which may crack the surface. Additionally, liquids and oils on the surface of a hot pot/pan can cause discoloration.

title: Vancouver
description: Vancouver Quartzite is a sophisticated natural stone originating from Brazil, favored for its striking balance of elegance and resilience. It showcases a luminous white or soft grey background, dramatically interlaced with sweeping, fluid veins in shades of charcoal, slate, and occasionally subtle emerald. Offering the timeless allure of marble with the superior hardness and heat resistance of granite, this material is ideal for high-traffic surfaces. Its dense composition ensures longevity, making it a premier selection for kitchen countertops and statement architectural features. Vancouver is a versatile natural stone suitable for a wide range of interior and exterior applications.

title: Vintage
description: Vintage quartz slab from Bolder Image Stone, Phoenix, Arizona. Vintage is a printed quartz slab: the veining is applied to the surface with high-definition 3D printing — like screen-printing a shirt — rather than running through the body of the stone. Cut edges expose the slab's white quartz core, so we recommend a mitered or waterfall edge (wraps the pattern over the edge so the design stays continuous) or a euro-style edge that shows the clean white edge as a deliberate accent.
